name: IMMREP23 TCR-epitope prediction challenge
description: Here, we present the findings from IMMREP23, the second benchmark competition focused on predicting the specificity of TCR-pMHC interactions
reputation: A recognized community challenge in computational immunology for TCR-epitope prediction, attracting specialized research groups.
notes: Biological datasets may suffer from class imbalance, dataset leakage/contamination (shared donors/sequences), cross-reactivity of TCRs, and limited labeled examples; not an LLM-native benchmark.
